answers.answer_text: Bú yào bǎ huà shuōde tài zhòng le.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Do whatever you want to do."
Write the Chinese for "I have too much homework; I'm really tired."

articles.text:
5. A: Zhèiwèi zài guówài yǒu míngde  What happened when this engineer who was
      gōngchéngshī, huí guó yǐhòu    famous abroad went back to his country?
      zěnmeyàng la?
   B: Huí guó yǐhòu yìzhí gǎo zhòng He has been doing technical work in
      gōngyè fāngmiànde jìshu        heavy industry since he returned to his
      gōngzuò.                       country.

Notes on No. 5

zěnmeyàng la?: "what happened (to him)?" LA is just a CONTRACTION of LE and A. More examples of the extremely useful word ZĚNMEYÀNG, "how is...," "what happened (to)...," or "do what":

Ránhòu ne? Ránhòu zěnmeyàng?     And then? Then what happened?
Ēi, hǎo jǐnián méi kànjian Xiǎo  Say, I haven't seen Xiǎo Wú for many
Wú le, tā zěnmeyàng le?          years. What ever became of her?
Yíge rén bù néng xiǎng zěnmeyàng A person cannot just do anything they
jiù zěnmeyàng.                   feel like doing.
Nǐ yàoshi bú gàosu ta, tā huì    If you don't tell him, will he try to do
duì nǐ zěnmeyàng ma?             anything to you?
A: Nǐ dǎsuàn zěnmeyàng?          What are you going to do?
B: Nǐ xiǎng wǒ yīnggāi zěnmeyàng? What do you think I should do?
A: Wǒ bù zhīdào, nǐ yào zěnmeyàng I don't know. Do whatever you want to
   jiù zěnmeyàng.                do.

zhòng: "to be heavy," in SEVERAL senses:

Zhèige jīqì yǒu duō zhòng?       How heavy is this machine?
Gōngkè tài zhòng, zhēn lèi.      I have too much homework; I'm really
                                 tired.
Bú yào bǎ huà shuōde tài zhòng   Don't put it too strongly.
le.
Tā shòule zhòng shāng, xiànzài   He was badly injured and is now in the
zài yīyuànli.                    hospital.

ZHÒNGLIÀNG means "weight" (compare chǎnliàng, zhìliàng, shùliàng).

The OPPOSITE of zhòng is QĪNG, "to be light."
